design: Longitudinal secondary analysis of versioned O*NET software-skill portfolios
source_name: O*NET Database 25.1 Technology Skills and O*NET Database 31.0 Software Skills
schema_history: O*NET documents that release 30.3 renamed Technology Skills to Software Skills and renamed Example / Commodity Code / Commodity Title to Workplace Example / Element ID / Element Name. Release 27.1 added In Demand.
content_update_note: In the O*NET 31.0 data dictionary, Software Skills lists release 30.3 as its most recent content update. O*NET 31.0 is the database snapshot used here; the software-skill content itself was most recently updated in 30.3.
license_note: O*NET database content is available under CC BY 4.0. Credit O*NET and USDOL/ETA, link the license, and indicate modifications.
claim_boundary: Observed database turnover combines labor-market change, taxonomy maintenance, data-collection updates, software/vendor naming changes, and measurement revisions. It is a renewal-pressure indicator, not a pure rate of human skill depreciation.
